clusters.name: Walter moving the family across the country, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move from Millbrook to Sorrel Valley in March 1952, within the next year: June became homesick and wrote daily to her sister, then kept to her bed for weeks; Walter spent long hours in the trees and grew distant from June; Glen got into fights at the new school; Walter stopped writing to his brother Harlan after a quarrel over their father's land money; he and June rowed over money for new trees. By September 1953, June had joined the church choir and her letters thinned out, marking where the period settled.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when the late frost came and the bank called in the loan: Walter began drinking heavily; he and Glen blamed each other; Glen and Marian took over the family's money and talks with the bank; Carl's asthma attacks grew worse that winter; you began wetting the bed again in April 1969; your mother kept it from your father. By October 1969, Walter had stopped drinking and taken work pruning other men's trees, marking where the family settled.

clusters.name: Glen losing his job at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen's job loss when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975: Glen sat out in the truck for hours most of that year; he and Marian fought loud fights over money at night; Marian took a second job cleaning offices to overfuntion; you stopped eating properly and lost weight that summer; you kept to your room and grew distant from your mother. By June 1976, when Glen started driving a delivery truck for the feed store, you were eating again and made the track team, marking where the period settled.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into your house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma selling her farm and moving into your house in January 1990: you clashed with Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals; Hollis worked late and kept out of the rows; Hollis took his mother's side; Owen had tantrums at preschool; Wilma took over Lily's care; you developed eczema on both hands; you and Hollis rowed most nights. In June 1991, Wilma took a flat in town, and over the summer your eczema cleared, marking where the period settled.
